name: Dependency Vulnerability Advisory Gate
description: Implement auditDependencies in src/dep-guard.ts to check requested package versions against an advisory database.

inputs.task_prompt: Implement auditDependencies(deps: Record<string, string>, advisories: Record<string, string[]>): string[] in src/dep-guard.ts. Return array of package names whose versions match known vulnerable advisory versions. Ensure test/dep-guard.test.ts passes.

acceptance_criteria: auditDependencies flags dependencies with advisory version matches
Returns empty array when all packages are safe
